name: Codex
summary: A terminal holding the Codex session that belongs to this epic, these parts and this kehikko.
guidance: A person on this canvas has a Codex CLI session open in a terminal, kept for exactly the epic, the picked parts and the kehikko in front of them. It is theirs: they type in it, and nothing here lets you type into it, start one or end one. Call `sessions` with the project path to see which sessions belong to which place — their first prompt, when each was last active, and whether a running one is working, waiting for its person or finished — before starting work that one of them may already hold. Call `sessions` with `place` to be told in words what a place holds.

mcp.about: Which Codex sessions a person keeps for which place (epic, picked parts, kehikko), and whether a running one is working, waiting for them or finished. Read-only: starts, ends and types nothing.

settings.label: Resume conversations cut off by a restart
settings.description: A conversation a restart stopped mid-turn is told what happened when you open it again, and carries on. Off: it waits for you.

settings.label: Model for new sessions
settings.description: The model a session started or resumed here asks for, as Codex names it (for example gpt-5.5). Empty: what your Codex config says.

settings.label: Reasoning effort
settings.description: How hard the model thinks before it answers, for sessions started or resumed here. Your Codex config decides when this is left at its default.

settings.label: When Codex asks before acting
settings.description: Ask when it needs to: Codex asks before a command leaves its sandbox. Never ask: such a command fails and Codex is told. Neither lets anything out of the sandbox unasked.
